_ghi_chu: EN-ALL GĐ 7 — bản phủ tiếng Anh (ban biên tập, chờ người bản xứ duyệt).
nguon: Pythagorean numerology (Personal Day) · traditional Vietnamese almanac (auspicious days, Day Officers, favourable / avoid lists, zodiac clashes and harmonies) · Bazi (Ten Gods of the day) · Plum Blossom numerology (hexagram of the day) · Xuan Kong + Eight Mansions (monthly stars, favourable directions)

thuan.tieu_de: {thu} {dm} — the smoothest day of the week
thuan.cau: The almanac marks this as a good day{hop}. If you have something ready to go, put it on this day.

hop_tuoi.tieu_de: {thu} {dm} — a day in harmony with your zodiac sign
hop_tuoi.cau: By the traditional calendar, this is {nghia}. Anything that needs other people's help is best arranged for this day.

cham.tieu_de: {thu} {dm} — a day to take it slowly
cham.cau: By the traditional calendar, this day clashes with your zodiac sign. If a big matter can be moved, move it to another day; everyday tasks can go ahead as usual.

mo_dau.cau: Personal Day 1: good for starting a small thing you have been thinking about for a long time.

khep.cau: Personal Day 9: good for tidying up and finishing loose ends before the next cycle begins.

hop.tam_hop: and in Three Harmony with your zodiac sign
hop.luc_hop: and in Six Harmony with your zodiac sign

tom_tat.co_dep: Between now and Sunday there are {so} days that are both good by the almanac and free of conflict with your zodiac sign{xung}.
tom_tat.co_dep_mot: Between now and Sunday there is one day that is both good by the almanac and free of conflict with your zodiac sign{xung}.
tom_tat.khong_dep: Between now and Sunday there is no day that is both good by the almanac and free of conflict with your zodiac sign{xung} — a week for familiar tasks.
tom_tat.xung: , plus one day that clashes with your sign

tuan.luu_y: The week's rhythm combines your Personal Days with the traditional calendar — a reference for planning, not a forecast.

push.khong_ngay: {tom_tat} Open it to see the rhythm of your seven days.

lich.dep: The almanac marks a good day — suited to {hop}.
lich.hoan: The almanac advises moving big matters to another day; everyday tasks can go ahead as usual.
lich.kieng: Folk custom avoids big matters on this day ({ky}); everyday tasks can go ahead as usual.
lich.nen: Day Officer {truc}: the almanac only recommends what is listed under Favourable for this day; other big matters can wait for another day.

tuoi.cau: By the traditional calendar, this is {nghia}.
tuoi.binh_cau: Your zodiac sign has no conflict with this day.

tom.thuan: Calendar and zodiac sign both favourable — a day worth giving to something you have prepared.
tom.thuan_viec: Calendar and zodiac sign both favourable — the almanac lists it as good for {viec}.
tom.kha: One of the two views (calendar, zodiac sign) is favourable, the other is neutral.
tom.kha_viec: The almanac lists it as good for {viec}; your zodiac sign has no conflict with this day.
tom.binh: An ordinary day by both calendar and zodiac sign — good for familiar tasks.
tom.lech: Calendar and zodiac sign point in different directions — small tasks are fine, pick another day for big ones.
tom.cham: A day to take it slowly: move big matters if you can, everyday tasks can go ahead as usual.
tom.kieng: Folk custom avoids big matters on this day ({ky}); everyday tasks can go ahead as usual.
tom.vuong: Today's relation with your zodiac sign is {ten} — everyday tasks are fine; where harmony matters, keep your words gentle.

moc.giao_tiet_cau: The solar month of {chi} begins — your home's monthly stars shift position from this day.
moc.lap_xuan_cau: The new solar year begins on this day (the year boundary used by Bazi and feng shui).

viec_tuan.luu_y: Based on the almanac, leaving out days that clash with your zodiac sign and days folk custom avoids. Other people's signs are not considered.

tuan.viec_xung: The almanac applies to everyone; this day clashes with your zodiac sign, so for your own big matters choose another day.
tuan.viec_kieng: The almanac lists the activities above as favourable, but folk custom avoids big matters on this day ({ky}) — whether to follow it is up to your family's customs.

nhan.gioi_thieu: Your seven days through five lenses. Tap a day to read it lens by lens.
nhan.ghi_chu: Zi Wei Dou Shu needs your birth time and reads month by month, so it has no line for each day.

cung_so.tieu_de: Today you are both on the same rhythm
cung_so.cau: You are both on Personal Day {a}. You read each other easily, but you may also both want the same thing at the same moment.
cung_so.viec_cung: Pick one thing you both want to do and do it together, rather than each going your own way.
cung_so.cau_tu_soi: What do you both want today that neither of you has said out loud?

cung_ra.tieu_de: Today you both want to act and to talk
cung_ra.cau: You are on day {a}, they are on day {b} — you are both turned outwards. Lots of energy, and it is easy for both of you to want to speak first.
cung_ra.viec_cung: Agree beforehand: each person finishes their point before the other speaks. For shared tasks, be clear about who does which part.
cung_ra.cau_tu_soi: In today's conversation, did you hear the other person out fully?

cung_vao.tieu_de: Today you both need to slow down
cung_vao.cau: You are on day {a}, they are on day {b} — you are both turned inwards. A good day to be together without needing to talk much.
cung_vao.viec_cung: A meal at home or a small task done together, no big discussions. Decisions can wait for another day.
cung_vao.cau_tu_soi: What today would be enough just by sitting side by side?

lech.tieu_de: Today your rhythms are a little out of step
lech.cau: You are on day {a}, they are on day {b} — one of you wants to act and talk, the other needs quiet. Being out of step is normal; nobody is in the wrong.
lech.viec_cung: Whoever has more energy asks first: "what do you need today?". Whoever needs quiet says clearly for how long.
lech.cau_tu_soi: Today, are you the one who wants to talk or the one who needs quiet?

hai_nguoi.luu_y: Built from both people's Personal Days for self-reflection — it does not rank the two of you and does not predict anything.
